text.p: The following are top stories from selected Singapore newspapers. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Punggol's lifestyle plans call for a unique seaside model town for the 21st century.
- Singapore Prime Minister Goh Chok Tong receives rousing welcome in Netherlands during his visit.
- Two Malaysian veteran Umno leaders lose posts in party elections.
- Analysts say U.S. semiconductor demand is unlikely to revive Singapore's sluggish electronics industry until early next year.
- Straits Trading Company clinches the top bid of Singapore $308 million for a state plot in China Square near Raffles Place.
- Funds managers and analysts welcome new Business Times Singapore Regional Index as indicator of regionalisation of local companies.
- Hong Leong group has plans to convert three-star Novotel Hotel into a boutique hospital.
- Chase Capital Partners and Management teams up with breakaway group from Mount Elizabeth Hospital chain to enter regional healthcare market.
- Showpla International is embarking on US$28 million expansion, including investing in new plants in Brazil and India to supply plastics components to Japanese electronics companies there.
- F&N Coca-Cola ties up with group of Pakistan interests to develop Coca-Cola business in the country.
- Inter-Roller Engineering proposing 1-for-2 rights issue and rewarding shareholders with a bonus isse, also on a 1-for-2 basis.
